name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 43 - Am 64
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 43a. Stresses that the outsourcing of cleaning, catering, childcare, travel agency and IT services services exposes the staff concerned, who are predominantly women, to often more precarious employment conditions, a deterioration in their working conditions and less favourable social protection; recalls that Parliament must set an example in terms of workers’ rights and job quality; accordingly calls for the in-house provision of those services, including the staff responsible for them, to be reinstated as soon as possible, with full respect for workers’ rights, fair remuneration, guarantees ensuring continuity of employment and compliance with the highest social and labour standards;
